task: Build analyze-batch.mjs: a purely offline analyzer that reads the four committed evidence streams (batch-ledger.jsonl, tamper-verdicts.jsonl, resume-reconciliation.json, protocol.json) and adjudicates hypotheses H1/H2/H3/H4 to a three-state verdict (pass|fail|inconclusive), emitting report.json + report.md with a reproducible sha256 digest; plus a hermetic selfcheck-m4.mjs proving the three-state logic is un-gameable, with a Codex cross-host digest replication.
outcome: Running `node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/analyze-batch.mjs` writes report.json + report.md and prints: 'H1 replay-determinism: pass', 'H2 tamper-fail-closed: pass', 'H3 resume-integrity: pass', 'H4 scale-envelope: pass', 'overall: all-pass', and 'digest: <sha256>'. Running `node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck-m4.mjs` prints 'selfcheck-m4 PASS' and exits 0. Re-running analyze-batch.mjs on the same committed inputs (even on a second host) prints the byte-identical digest — the campaign's reproducible H1-H4 trust anchor.
facts: The four evidence artifacts exist and are committed on main under experiments/pos-instrument-replay/: batch-ledger.jsonl (33 proof records, keys incl. verifyStatus/digests/goldMetrics/elapsedMs/scale), tamper-verdicts.jsonl (27 verdicts, keys incl. verifyStatus/fingerprintMatch/dispositionMatch/rederivedDisposition/expectedDisposition), resume-reconciliation.json (dupTotal/gapTotal/finalMultisetMatch), protocol.json (N, budgetCaps.msPerVerify=128217, tamperMatrix, envPins).
The proof records use verifyStatus (NOT a bare status key) — INIT-001 advisory.
lib/instrument.mjs exports sha256 and canonicalJson to reuse.

H1: per scale with >=2 proof records, all records must have pairwise-equal {digests, goldMetrics}. H2: each verdict conforms to its bucket rule (fail-closed->verify fail|crash + fingerprintMatch; accepted/acknowledged-limitation->verify pass + fingerprintMatch; dropped->verify pass) AND dispositionMatch all true AND counts match protocol.tamperMatrix. H3: dupTotal==0 && gapTotal==0 && finalMultisetMatch. H4: every proof record elapsedMs <= budgetCaps.msPerVerify.
A validated spike confirms all four adjudicate pass on the real evidence and the digest (sha256 of canonicalJson(report minus digest)) reproduces.
constraints: OFFLINE ONLY: analyze-batch.mjs must NEVER re-execute the instrument and NEVER call the lattice CLI — it only reads committed evidence files.
Three-state is first-class: missing/insufficient/tampered evidence must map to inconclusive or fail, NEVER a false pass.
Reuse lib/instrument.mjs sha256/canonicalJson (single hashing convention); digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus the digest field)).
Do NOT modify any earlier-milestone file (run-batch.mjs, tamper.mjs, resume-probe.mjs, selfcheck-m1/m2/m3.mjs) or the instrument (packages/).
report.md must be human-readable and include the env pins (nodeVersion/platform/instrumentCommit) from protocol.json (product-review advisory).
unknowns: Exact report.md layout and whether to embed the plan section-3 claim text verbatim when all hypotheses pass (leaning yes per the no-overclaim rule).
